title: business.json — JuanStack Vertical DNA Schema
description: Defines the configuration contract for every JuanStack vertical repository. dannflow reads this file at build time to configure features, UI terminology, BIR rules, and AI persona.

vertical_id.description: Unique snake_case identifier for this vertical. Used to resolve namespace paths (e.g., src/bir/{vertical_id}/).

name.description: Human-readable display name for this vertical.

description.description: One-sentence description of what this vertical manages.

owned_paths.description: Paths in the dannflow repo that this vertical OWNS. sync-to-upstream will HARD BLOCK any staged file outside this list.

domain_nomenclature.description: Domain-specific terminology. ALL UI components must read from here — never hardcode these words in .tsx files.

provider.description: The professional or service provider (e.g., Lawyer, Veterinarian, Chef).

consumer.description: The end recipient of the service (e.g., Client, Pet Owner, Diner).

transaction.description: The primary unit of work (e.g., Billable Case, Appointment, Order).

inventory_item.description: The primary inventory item if applicable. null if inventory is not used.

dannflow_features.description: Feature flags. Set to true to activate the module. Components must check isFeatureEnabled() before rendering.

billing_module.description: Stripe subscription billing and plan gating.

inventory_management.description: Product/inventory CRUD for verticals that sell goods.

pos_terminal.description: Point-of-sale terminal UI and payment processing.

bir_module.description: Philippine BIR tax compliance module. Loads forms from src/bir/{vertical_id}/.

analytics_module.description: Analytics dashboard. Loads KPI components from src/analytics/{vertical_id}/.

ai_secretary.description: Proactive AI Secretary system. Requires Supabase Edge Function deployment.

scheduling_module.description: Calendar and scheduling system with optional AI booking hooks.

scheduling_rules.description: Scheduling configuration for this vertical. Required when dannflow_features.scheduling_module is true.

requires_owner_approval.description: If true, AI cannot auto-book; it must request approval from the business owner.

bir_rules.description: Philippine BIR tax configuration for this vertical. Required when dannflow_features.bir_module is true.

module_path.description: Path to this vertical's BIR form templates within dannflow.

taxpayer_classification.description: Default BIR taxpayer classification per RA 11976 (EOPT Act). Micro = under ₱3M gross sales.

withholding_tax_percentage.description: Creditable withholding tax rate for this industry (e.g., 10 for professional services).

eligible_for_8_percent_gross.description: Whether this vertical can elect the 8% gross receipt tax option instead of graduated rates.

applicable_laws.description: List of applicable Philippine laws and regulations.

atc_percentage_tax.description: Alphanumeric Tax Code for Percentage Tax (e.g., PT010).

atc_income_tax.description: Alphanumeric Tax Code for Income Tax (e.g., II012, II014).

atc_withholding_tax.description: Alphanumeric Tax Code for Creditable Withholding Tax (e.g., WI157).

ai_rules.description: AI Secretary configuration. Required when dannflow_features.ai_secretary is true.

persona_manifest.description: Path to the vertical-specific AI manifest within dannflow.

system_prompt_persona.description: The system-level persona description sent to the AI model at the start of every session.

tone.description: Communication tone of the AI Secretary.

hard_limits.description: Absolute behavioral restrictions. The AI must never violate these.
examples: Never provide legal advice. Administrative guidance only.
Never access or display another client's case data.
Always confirm before sending any external communication.
